subject: Английский язык
authors: Биболетова М. З., Денисенко О. А., Tрубанева Н. Н.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 1

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 4. Посмотри на картинку, послушай запись и вспомни, как учитель мистер Гринвуд знакомится с учениками лесной школы.
steps: Фразы знакомства: What's your name? — My name is … / I am … Nice to meet you! Welcome!
problems.answer: Полезные фразы: What's your name? — My name is … Nice to meet you! Welcome to Green School!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 4. Послушай запись и продолжи с одноклассником сцену знакомства по картинке.
steps: Mr Greenwood: What's your name? — Martin: My name is Martin. — Nice to meet you, Martin. What's your name? — Peter: I am Peter. — Welcome, Peter!
Дальше по кругу: Pam, Nick, Jack, Jane, Bess, Mary, Thomas, Billy — каждый называет своё имя, учитель отвечает Nice to meet you! / Welcome!
problems.answer: — What's your name? — My name is Martin. — Nice to meet you, Martin. What's your name? — I am Peter. — Welcome, Peter! (и так со всеми учениками: Pam, Nick, Jack, Jane, Bess, Mary, Thomas, Billy).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 4. Сосчитай учеников на картинке и скажи, кто они и как их зовут.
steps: There are ten pupils. He is a bear. His name is Billy. He is a pig. His name is Peter. He is a rabbit. His name is Martin. She is a monkey. Her name is Pam. He is a cockerel. His name is Nick.
He is a dog. His name is Jack. She is a cat. Her name is Jane. She is a fox. Her name is Bess. She is a mouse. Her name is Mary. He is an elephant. His name is Thomas.
problems.answer: Ten pupils: Billy the bear, Peter the pig, Martin the rabbit, Pam the monkey, Nick the cockerel, Jack the dog, Jane the cat, Bess the fox, Mary the mouse, Thomas the elephant.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 5. Посмотри на картинку на с. 4 и скажи, какая тема урока; вспомни и спой песенку «The ABC».
steps: На доске — буквы, значит тема урока — «The ABC» (алфавит). Поём песенку про алфавит.
problems.answer: The ABC.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 5, с. 5. Послушай и прочитай слова.
steps: Читаем слова за диктором, обращая внимание на правила чтения гласных.
problems.answer: Слова читаются вслух за диктором.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 6, с. 5. Прочитай, что Билли рассказал об однокласснике, и догадайся, кто он.
steps: Он маленький, умеет прыгать и любит морковку — это кролик Мартин.
problems.answer: He is a rabbit (Martin).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 7, с. 5. Расскажи о своём однокласснике, не называя имени, по моделям в упражнении.
steps: Пример: I have got a friend. He is clever. He is not fat. He can play tennis. He cannot skate. We go to school together.
problems.answer: I have got a friend. He is clever. He is not fat. He can play tennis. He cannot skate. We go to school together.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, домашнее задание, с. 5. Дополни предложения Мэри о её друге.
steps: 2) name, 4) small, 5) swim, 6) jump, 7) school.
problems.answer: name, small, swim, jump, school.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 2

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 6. Послушай, что новый ученик рассказал о себе мистеру Гринвуду, и заполни за него анкету.
steps: Name: Dino. Age: seven. Can: skip and swim. Family: mum and dad.
problems.answer: Name — Dino; age — 7; can — skip and swim; family — mum and dad.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 6. Расскажи, что ты запомнил(-а) о динозаврике.
steps: His name is Dino. He is seven. He can skip and swim. He has got a mum and a dad.
problems.answer: His name is Dino. He is seven. He can skip and swim. He has got a mum and a dad.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 3, с. 6. Посмотри на картинку и скажи, какого цвета учебники у учеников.
steps: Bess has got a red textbook. Jane has got a grey textbook. Billy has got a yellow textbook. Pam has got a blue textbook. Nick has got a green textbook.
Thomas has got a brown textbook. Mary has got a black textbook. Peter has got a white textbook. Jack has got an orange textbook.
problems.answer: Bess — red, Jane — grey, Billy — yellow, Pam — blue, Nick — green, Thomas — brown, Mary — black, Peter — white, Jack — orange.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 6. Проверь внимательность соседа по парте: задай вопросы о цвете учебников.
steps: — Has Mary got a brown textbook? — No, she hasn't. She has got a black textbook. — Has Thomas got a brown textbook? — Yes, he has.
problems.answer: — Has Mary got a brown textbook? — No, she hasn't. She's got a black textbook. — Has Thomas got a brown textbook? — Yes, he has.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 5, с. 6. a) Послушай и прочитай слова. b) Прочитай слова самостоятельно.
steps: name, pencil, student, nine, music, angry, kind, live, three, rule, long, tree, blue, strong, funny, welcome, jump, school, together.
problems.answer: name, pencil, student, nine, music, angry, kind, live, three, rule, long, tree, blue, strong, funny, welcome, jump, school, together.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 6, с. 7. Прочитай записку мистера Гринвуда, посмотри на картинки и назови учеников, которые неверно поняли задание.
steps: Задание поняли неверно Dino и Thomas.
problems.answer: Dino and Thomas.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, домашнее задание, с. 7. Напиши задания для учеников лесной школы по образцу.
steps: Thomas! Go home, please. Dino! Count the flowers, please. Jane! Go to school, please. Peter! Sing a song, please. Billy! Take four pencils, please.
problems.answer: Thomas! Go home, please. Dino! Count the flowers, please. Jane! Go to school, please. Peter! Sing a song, please. Billy! Take four pencils, please.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 3

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 8. Послушай рассказ, найди фотографию новой учительницы и назови её имя.
steps: Фотография 3. Новую учительницу зовут Miss Chatter.
problems.answer: Photo 3 — Miss Chatter.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 8. Расскажи мисс Четтер об одном из учеников лесной школы.
steps: Например: Pam is a monkey. She is funny. She can climb. Другие ученики: Jack is a dog, Jane is a cat, Martin is a rabbit, Billy is a bear, Thomas is an elephant, Mary is a mouse, Bess is a fox, Nick is a cockerel, Peter is a pig.
problems.answer: Pam is a monkey. She is funny. She can climb. (Jack — a dog, Jane — a cat, Martin — a rabbit, Billy — a bear, Thomas — an elephant, Mary — a mouse, Bess — a fox, Nick — a cockerel, Peter — a pig.)

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 8. Расскажи свою любимую английскую песенку или рифмовку.
steps: Например, песенка «Head, shoulders, knees and toes» — о частях тела: голова, плечи, колени, пальцы ног, глаза, уши, рот, нос.
problems.answer: Например, «Head, shoulders, knees and toes» — песенка о частях тела.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 8. Прочитай вопросы и ответь на них от лица одного из учеников лесной школы.
steps: My name is Mary. I'm a mouse. I'm nine. I live in the forest. Yes, I can. Yes, I can. No, I can't. No, I haven't.
problems.answer: My name is Mary. I'm a mouse. I'm nine. I live in the forest. Yes, I can. Yes, I can. No, I can't. No, I haven't.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 9. a) Опроси одноклассников, что они умеют делать хорошо, и заполни таблицу. b) Скажи, кого возьмёшь в свою команду и почему.
steps: a) Can you run well? Can you swim well? Can you skip well? Can you jump well? — отмечаем ответы в таблице.
b) Пример: My team: Ksusha, Alexey and Damir. Ksusha can jump and run well. Alexey can swim well. Damir can skip, run and swim well.
problems.answer: a) Can you run / swim / skip / jump well? b) My team: Ksusha (can jump and run well), Alexey (can swim well), Damir (can skip, run and swim well).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, домашнее задание, с. 9. Прочитай вопросы и ответь на них от лица одного из учеников лесной школы.
steps: My name is Mary. I'm a mouse. I'm nine. I live in the forest. Yes, I can. Yes, I can. No, I can't. No, I haven't.
problems.answer: My name is Mary. I'm a mouse. I'm nine. I live in the forest. Yes, I can. Yes, I can. No, I can't. No, I haven't.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 4

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 9. Послушай, какие продукты купила мисс Четтер, найди их на картинке и повтори названия.
steps: egg — яйцо, milk — молоко, ham — ветчина, fish — рыба, bread — хлеб, butter — масло, cheese — сыр, juice — сок, cake — торт, sweet — конфета.
problems.answer: egg, milk, ham, fish, bread, butter, cheese, juice, cake, sweets.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 10. Узнай у одноклассника, что он любит есть, по модели Do you like …?
steps: — Do you like sweets? — Yes, I do. — Do you like eggs? — No, I don't. — Do you like milk? — Yes, I do. — Do you like ham? — No, I don't. — Do you like fish? — No, I don't.
— Do you like bread? — Yes, I do. — Do you like butter? — Yes, I do. — Do you like cheese? — No, I don't. — Do you like juice? — No, I don't. — Do you like cakes? — Yes, I do.
problems.answer: — Do you like sweets? — Yes, I do. — Do you like eggs? — No, I don't. (и так с каждым продуктом)

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 10. Прочитай слова и скажи, как буква a читается в каждой строчке.
steps: a) /æ/ — закрытый слог (cat, hat); b) /eɪ/ — открытый слог (name, cake); c) /ɑː/ — перед r (car, park).
problems.answer: a — /æ/, b — /eɪ/, c — /ɑː/.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 10. Прочитай словосочетания, назови номера подходящих рисунков и скажи, каких рисунков не хватает.
steps: Есть рисунки: a black car, a blue hat, a black cat. Не хватает рисунков: a dark park, a smart student, a brave dog.
problems.answer: Есть: a black car, a blue hat, a black cat. Не хватает: a dark park, a smart student, a brave dog.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, домашнее задание, с. 10. Составь и запиши предложения из слов.
steps: We are students. Do you like sweets? I like black cars. Do they go to school?
problems.answer: We are students. Do you like sweets? I like black cars. Do they go to school?

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 5

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 11. Послушай разговор и скажи, чем мисс Четтер угощает учеников.
steps: Miss Chatter treats the pupils to cheese, bread, fish and ham.
problems.answer: Cheese, bread, fish and ham.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 11. Представь, что к тебе пришли гости. Разыграй диалог за праздничным столом.
steps: — Do you like cheese? — Yes, I do. — Help yourself! — Do you like milk? — No, I don't. But I like juice. — Help yourself! — Would you like some bread? — Yes, thank you.
problems.answer: — Do you like cheese? — Yes, I do. — Help yourself! — Would you like some bread? — Yes, thank you.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 3, с. 11. Прочитай диалог по ролям.
steps: — Do you like milk? — Yes, I do. — Would you like some milk? — Yes, please. — Help yourself! — Thank you!
problems.answer: — Do you like milk? — Yes, I do. — Would you like some milk? — Yes, please. — Help yourself! — Thank you!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 4, с. 11. Прочитай слова со звуком /ɑː/.
steps: park, farmer, farm, bar, star, garden, mark, arm, smart, car, are.
problems.answer: park, farmer, farm, bar, star, garden, mark, arm, smart, car, are.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 5, с. 12. Прочитай слова вслух.
steps: park, farmer, farm, bar, star, garden, mark, arm, smart, car, are; are, butter, cake, egg, park, milk, car, they.
problems.answer: park, farmer, farm, bar, star, garden, mark, arm, smart, car, are, butter, cake, egg, milk, they.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, домашнее задание, с. 12. Ответь на вопросы о себе.
steps: Пример: My name is Anna. Yes, I do. No, I don't. Yes, I can. Yes, I do. No, I don't. Yes, I can. Yes, I am.
problems.answer: My name is … Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, I can. / No, I can't. Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 6

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 1, с. 12. Капризная лисичка Бесс собирается в школу. Прочитай начало её разговора с мамой за завтраком и продолжи диалог.
steps: Mother: Would you like some cheese? — Bess: No, thank you. — Would you like some butter and bread? — No, thank you. — Would you like some tea? — No, thank you.
— Would you like an egg? — No, thank you. — Would you like some sweets? — Yes, please!
problems.answer: — Would you like some cheese? — No, thank you. — Would you like some bread and butter? — No, thank you. — Would you like some tea? — No, thank you. — Would you like some sweets? — Yes, please!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 2, с. 12. Послушай и повтори бормоталку, которую придумал медвежонок.
steps: I like to fly! I like to swim! I like to run, jump and sing! — Я люблю летать, плавать, бегать, прыгать и петь.
problems.answer: I like to fly! I like to swim! I like to run, jump and sing!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 3, с. 12. Скажи, что ты любишь делать, по образцу I like to …
steps: I like to sing. I like to dance. I like to draw. I like to jump. I like to run. I like to swim. I like to read. I like to write. I like to walk. I like to go to school.
problems.answer: I like to sing / dance / draw / jump / run / swim / read / write / walk / go to school.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 4, с. 13. Составь предложения, соединив начало, середину и окончание из трёх колонок таблицы.
steps: I like to ride a bike. We like to live on a farm. You like to skate in the park. They like to ride a bike. He likes to sing at home. She likes to live on a farm.
problems.answer: I like to ride a bike. We like to live on a farm. You like to skate in the park. They like to ride a bike. He likes to sing at home. She likes to live on a farm.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 5, с. 13. Прочитай сначала слова со звуком /ɒ/, потом со звуком /əʊ/.
steps: /ɒ/: strong, frog, dog, cockerel, box, song, forest, not, long, fox. /əʊ/: go, home, nose, no, close, rose, toe.
problems.answer: /ɒ/: strong, frog, dog, cockerel, box, song, forest, not, long, fox; /əʊ/: go, home, nose, no, close, rose, toe.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, упр. 6, с. 13. Прочитай письмо и скажи, что умеет делать Рекс.
steps: Rex can take Jill's bag to school. He can count pens and pencils, sing songs and dance well.
problems.answer: Rex can take Jill's bag to school, count pens and pencils, sing songs and dance well.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, домашнее задание, с. 13. Составь и запиши предложения по образцу.
steps: I like to sing and dance well. You like to live in the forest. He likes to play tennis. She likes to read books at home. We like to skip in the park. They like to go home.
problems.answer: I like to sing and dance well. You like to live in the forest. He likes to play tennis. She likes to read books at home. We like to skip in the park. They like to go home.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 7

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 7, упр. 1, с. 14. Послушай и скажи, что ребята увидели в школьном саду.
steps: potatoes and corn — картофель и кукуруза; red and green apples — красные и зелёные яблоки; cabbage, carrots and tomatoes — капуста, морковь и помидоры; nuts — орехи.
problems.answer: Potatoes, corn, red and green apples, cabbage, carrots, tomatoes and nuts.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 7, упр. 2, с. 14. Разыграй с одноклассником беседу Билли и его друзей за столом.
steps: Billy: Jill! Would you like some cheese? — Jill: Yes, please. / No, thank you. — Would you like some bread? — Yes, please. — Would you like some juice? — No, thank you. — Would you like some cake? — Yes, please. — Help yourself!
problems.answer: — Would you like some cheese? — Yes, please. — Would you like some bread? — No, thank you. — Would you like some juice? — Yes, please. — Help yourself!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 7, упр. 3, с. 14. Послушай, повтори и прочитай пары слов вслух.
steps: but — farm, mum — park, run — car, duck — dark, butter — are, clock — short, long — corn, not — horse, fox — or, frog — morning.
problems.answer: but — farm, mum — park, run — car, duck — dark, butter — are, clock — short, long — corn, not — horse, fox — or, frog — morning.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 7, упр. 4, с. 14. Прочитай сначала слова со звуком /ɔː/, потом со звуком /ɑː/.
steps: /ɔː/: for, short, or, corn, morning, horse. /ɑː/: farm, are, farmer, park, car, dark.
problems.answer: /ɔː/: for, short, or, corn, morning, horse; /ɑː/: farm, are, farmer, park, car, dark.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 7, упр. 5, с. 15. Прочитай загадку, которую Билли загадал гостям, и отгадай её.
steps: Большое сильное животное с фермы, умеет бегать, любит траву и морковь — лошадь.
problems.answer: A horse.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 7, упр. 6, с. 15. Придумай и загадай загадку друзьям.
steps: Пример: I have got a friend. It is small and fluffy. It lives on a farm. It can run. It is white. It likes carrots and grass. (A sheep.)
problems.answer: It is small and fluffy. It lives on a farm. It is white. It likes grass. — A sheep.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 7, домашнее задание, с. 15. Распредели слова по трём колонкам: существительное, вспомогательный глагол, глагол.
steps: Существительные: a farm, a horse, a car, milk, a cake, sweets, butter, a park, a frog, a school. Вспомогательные глаголы: are, is, am. Глаголы: go, read, like, run, swim.
problems.answer: Существительные — farm, horse, car, milk, cake, sweets, butter, park, frog, school; вспомогательные — am, is, are; глаголы — go, read, like, run, swim.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 8

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 8, упр. 1, с. 15. Послушай рассказ Билли и ответь на его вопрос.
steps: Билли спрашивает: Do you like honey and sweets? — Yes, I do. I like honey and sweets. / No, I don't.
problems.answer: Yes, I do. I like honey and sweets. / No, I don't.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 8, упр. 2, с. 15. Восстанови рассказ Билли, используя данные слова.
steps: I'm Billy. I live in the forest. I think I'm very nice. I have got a friend. His name is Martin. I go to school. I can write. I like sweets, honey, jam and sandwiches. But I don't like cabbage and corn. Do you like honey and sweets?
problems.answer: I'm Billy. I live in the forest. I think I'm very nice. I have got a friend. His name is Martin. I go to school. I can write. I like sweets, honey, jam and sandwiches. But I don't like cabbage and corn. Do you like honey and sweets?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 8, упр. 3, с. 15. Прочитай сочетания слов, скажи, какие подходят к Билли, и составь предложения с остальными.
steps: Billy is nice, fat, funny, kind, smart and happy. Liza is brave. Mark is sad. My brother is very lazy. My little sister is not big. She is not very brave, but nice.
problems.answer: Billy is nice, fat, funny, kind, smart and happy. Liza is brave. Mark is sad. My brother is lazy. My little sister is not big, but nice.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 8, упр. 4, с. 16. Прочитай рассказ Билли и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Yes, he does. Yes, he has. Yes, he can. Yes, he does. No, he doesn't. Yes, he does.
problems.answer: Yes, he does. Yes, he has. Yes, he can. Yes, he does. No, he doesn't. Yes, he does.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 8, упр. 5, с. 16. Предположи, какая еда нравится ученикам лесной школы (Does … like …?).
steps: — Does Mary like milk? — Yes, she does. — Does Billy like sweets? — Yes, he does. — Does Martin like butter? — No, he doesn't. — Does Pam like jam? — No, she doesn't. — Does Mary like tomatoes? — Yes, she does.
problems.answer: Does Mary like milk? — Yes, she does. Does Billy like sweets? — Yes, he does. Does Martin like butter? — No, he doesn't. Does Pam like jam? — No, she doesn't.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 8, упр. 6, с. 16. Разыграй разговор за столом между Джилл (Джимом) и учеником лесной школы.
steps: Jill: Good morning, Billy. — Billy: Good morning, Jill. — Do you like cheese? — Yes, I do. — Help yourself! — Do you like milk? — No, I don't. But I like juice. — Help yourself! — Would you like some bread? — Yes, thank you.
problems.answer: — Good morning, Billy. — Good morning, Jill. — Do you like cheese? — Yes, I do. — Help yourself! — Would you like some bread? — Yes, thank you.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 8, домашнее задание, с. 16. Восстанови рассказ Билли, используя данные слова.
steps: I'm Billy. I live in the forest. I think I'm very nice. I have got a friend. His name is Martin. I go to school. I can write. I like sweets, honey, jam and sandwiches. But I don't like cabbage and corn. Do you like honey and sweets?
problems.answer: I'm Billy. I live in the forest. I have got a friend, Martin. I go to school. I can write. I like sweets, honey, jam and sandwiches, but I don't like cabbage and corn.

chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 9

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, упр. 1, с. 17. Послушай, запомни и повтори стишок.
steps: Билли предлагает мышкам кусочек льда (a piece of ice), а те хотят кусочек сыра (a piece of cheese) — и Билли просит сказать «please».

problems.answer: Monday — porridge and tea; Tuesday — a banana, an apple, tea; Wednesday — an egg, a ham sandwich, coffee; Thursday — cornflakes and milk; Friday — a cake and juice.

problems.answer: Monday — porridge and tea; Tuesday — a banana, an apple and tea; Wednesday — an egg, a ham sandwich and coffee; Thursday — cornflakes and milk; Friday — a cake and juice.

problems.answer: I think this menu is the best because it is tasty and healthy.
